@graph.schema:name: The Clinical Epidemiologic Audit of Cholera in Malawi: A Medical Record Review of the 2022 Outbreak
@graph.schema:version: v0.1: Raw data from data entry
@graph.schema:description: The study evaluated the mortality burden of cholera and the quality of patient treatment in cholera treatment units in Lilongwe, Blantyre, Mangochi and Nkhata-Bay districts in Malawi. The purpose of this study was to better understand the factors contributing to the high cholera mortality burden in these districts and to identify areas for improvement in patient treatment.
